items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: One time I sat in with Roland used to send me in to sub with Thad Jones and Mel Lewis.

ctx.x: Well I had anxious moments like that. One time I sat in with Roland used to send me in to sub with Thad Jones and Mel Lewis. And that book is in tatters, it was then. He knew the book by heart. He’d been there forever after Hank. So, and he played this prank. He was a prankster in those days.
